# one tap, mCurrentRotation=ROTATION_90 (user_rotation=1), sendevent at natural (540,700) = same physical point as the portrait capture; display coords (700,540) on 2400x1080
# NOTE: events were injected with sendevent; the kernel drops axes whose value did not change since the previous contact (here ABS_MT_SLOT, ABS_MT_POSITION_X, ABS_MT_PRESSURE, ABS_MT_TOUCH_MAJOR), and this node has no BTN_TOUCH key, so EV_KEY BTN_TOUCH is never reported.
